product_description: Welcome prosperity and festive charm into your home with this handcrafted toran, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, decorative peacock-eye designs, a beautiful Lord Ganesha centerpiece, golden detailing, and elegant pearl tassels. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, weddings, and traditional entrance décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearls and decorative embellishments carefully.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
